name: María (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with a white eagle displayed facing the viewer, above two branches of belladonna and beneath a marquess's crown.
history: María adopted its arms and flag officially on 26 April 2005; the flag is a cloth of 2:3, blue with an eagle facing the viewer over two branches of belladonna and surmounted by a marquess's crown, all in white.

features.role: eagle facing the viewer with belladonna branches and a marquess's crown
